question: Which state on 23 December 2021, passed Shakti Criminal Laws?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra** passed the Shakti Criminal Laws on **23 December 2021**.
 
• The Shakti Act is aimed at strengthening laws against crimes such as rape, acid attacks, and child abuse.
 
• It includes provisions for faster investigation and trial, with a deadline of 30 days for investigation and 45 days for trial.
 
• The act also introduces stringent punishment, including the death penalty for severe cases.
 
• It is designed to ensure swift justice and act as a deterrent against heinous crimes, particularly those against women and children.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Shakti Act is named after the Marathi word for "power" or "strength," symbolizing empowerment and protection for victims.
 
• The act was inspired by the Disha Act passed in Andhra Pradesh, which also focuses on expediting the judicial process for crimes against women.
 
• Implementation of the act includes setting up exclusive courts for the trial of offenses under this law to ensure speedy justice.
 
• The state government has also planned awareness programs and training for law enforcement officials to effectively enforce the Shakti Act.
